cards.title: Shared Laughter
cards.line: You know it's forever love when the silliest inside jokes still make you laugh so hard your stomach aches, even after all these years.
cards.caption:
It's in the shared giggles and the goofy dance moves that true companionship truly shines, reminding you of the precious, lighthearted foundation you've built together. What little moments of everyday joy do you cherish most with your loved ones?

cards.title: Quiet Hope
cards.body:
It's easy to believe the best is behind you.
After seasons that tested your spirit,
a tender quiet can feel unfamiliar.
But gentle love often waits patiently,
not rushing, but simply arriving
when you’re ready to receive it.
Trust that warmth knows its way home,
and so do gentle hands.
cards.caption:
The heart has a tender wisdom, knowing when to open again to quiet moments of connection. What small, gentle hope are you holding onto today?

video_reels.title: Daily Choice
video_reels.line: The true rhythm of a lasting love isn't grand gestures, but the quiet, daily choice to show up and care, even when nothing much is happening.

engagement.title: Mom's Wisdom
engagement.prompt: The best love advice my mother or grandmother gave me was...
engagement.caption:
There's something so special about the wisdom passed down through generations, isn't there? Our mothers and grandmothers often had a way of seeing straight to the heart of things, especially when it came to love, partnership, and building a life together. Their advice wasn't always fancy, but it was always true. What gem of advice about love or marriage did your mother or grandmother share with you that still resonates today? reflections.title: A Thought
reflections.quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
reflections.author: Audrey Hepburn
reflections.essay:
Have you ever read a line that stops you in your tracks?

Audrey Hepburn once said:

"The best thing to hold onto in life is each other."

Isn't that the truth? Sometimes the most precious things in our lives are the quiet, ordinary ones — a familiar laugh, a hand held across the table, a slow morning that felt like nothing at the time.

Until one day, we realize those small moments were the whole gift.

So today, let's linger a little longer. Love a little louder. And tell the people who matter just how much they do.

Because the smallest moments often leave the biggest imprint on our hearts. 💛
